settings.title: How to use
settings.content: Strap it on, press the button and let the soft kneading do the work during quiet time. Stay close and keep sessions short.

settings.title: Safe use
settings.content:
• Always stay with your pet while the massager is on.
  • Keep sessions short and stop if your pet seems uncomfortable.
